metadata.question: Was the ash plume from Klyuchevskaya Sopka drifting primarily eastward across the Kamchatka Peninsula on August 8, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Klyuchevskaya Sopka volcano in Kamchatka, Russia (~56.06°N, 160.64°E) - Date: August 8, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for visual/true color to see ash plume direction, or MODIS for thermal/aerosol detection - Need to identify ash plume and determine its direction relative to the volcano 2. Masking strategy: - This is about detecting an ash plume, so I should NOT mask clouds heavily - Ash plumes appear similar to clouds but have distinct characteristics - Use true color or false color composite to visualize the plume - The question is specifically about the plume direction, not cloud-free areas 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - A (Yes): Plume is visible and predominantly extends eastward - B (No): Plume exists but extends in other directions (west, north, south) - C1: No images available for this date/location - C2: Images exist but cannot be processed (unlikely for this case) - C3: Cannot determine plume direction from available data I'll use aerosol index or visual inspection of RGB composite to determine plume direction. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([160.64, 56.06]); const date = '2025-08-08'; // Define regions to check plume direction (east, west, north, south of volcano) const eastRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([160.64, 55.8, 162.0, 56.3]); const westRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([159.0, 55.8, 160.64, 56.3]); const northRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([160.3, 56.06, 160.98, 56.5]); const southRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([160.3, 55.5, 160.98, 56.06]); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Sentinel-2 first let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); let collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); // If no Sentinel-2, try MODIS Terra if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('Trying MODIS Terra...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA') .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images found: ${collectionSize}`); } if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No imagery available for this date and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Use Aerosol Index to detect ash plume const image = collection.first(); // For Sentinel-2, calculate aerosol optical thickness proxy using blue/red ratio const aerosol = image.select('B1').divide(image.select('B4')); // Calculate mean aerosol values in each direction const eastStats = await aerosol.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: eastRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const westStats = await aerosol.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: westRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const northStats = await aerosol.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: northRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const southStats = await aerosol.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const eastMean = eastStats.B1_mean; const westMean = westStats.B1_mean; const northMean = northStats.B1_mean; const southMean = southStats.B1_mean; console.log(`East aerosol index: ${eastMean !== null ? eastMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`West aerosol index: ${westMean !== null ? westMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`North aerosol index: ${northMean !== null ? northMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`South aerosol index: ${southMean !== null ? southMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (eastMean === null && westMean === null && northMean === null && southMean === null) { console.log('Cannot calculate aerosol index - no valid pixels.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Determine primary direction based on highest aerosol index const directions = { 'East': eastMean || 0, 'West': westMean || 0, 'North': northMean || 0, 'South': southMean || 0 }; const maxDirection = Object.keys(directions).reduce((a, b) => directions[a] > directions[b] ? a : b); console.log(`Primary plume direction: ${maxDirection} (index: ${directions[maxDirection].toFixed(3)})`); if (maxDirection === 'East' && directions['East'] > directions['West'] * 1.2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
